summary: seal_epoch maps durable payload/hash-chain corruption found by _validated_session_history to an ordinary REJECTED_STATE and never latches the store.
failure_scenario: A stored event row whose payload_hash/record_hash/previous_hash no longer matches (mid-run damage after the startup _validate_durable_evidence pass) -> seal_epoch raises EvidenceFrameError from _validated_session_history -> caught by the (EvidenceModelError, EvidenceFrameError, TypeError, ValueError) clause -> rollback and REJECTED_STATE, no STORE_CORRUPT latch; the same session keeps accepting appends (append path uses unvalidated _session_history and _previous_hash) and the caller sees a refusal indistinguishable from a legitimate state rejection.
evidence: Static read of seal_epoch (lines ~2940-3010), _validated_session_history (1776-1818) and _append/_plan_append (2062-2230). The earlier try that catches EvidenceStorageError does not cover the BEGIN IMMEDIATE block. Not executed: no synthetic reproduction was run. Fail-closed refusal is the existing behavior; the defect is only the missing latch/evidence of corruption.

summary: _granted_sids counts only ACCESS_ALLOWED (0x00) and ACCESS_ALLOWED_OBJECT (0x05) ACEs, so allow-type callback ACEs (0x09, 0x0B) grant access without being counted.
failure_scenario: A conditional (callback) allow ACE for a non-owner SID is present on the evidence root/database -> the loop skips it via 'continue' -> _path_grants_only_owner returns True -> _require_owner_only_dacl passes although a foreign principal has access.
evidence: Static read of _granted_sids and the ACE-type constants (lines 826-837, 975-1000). Windows-only API (ctypes advapi32); cannot run on this Linux host. Reachability needs someone able to write the DACL, so impact is limited to weakening the tamper check.

summary: Prior claim sqlite_spool.py:2082 (append re-parses whole session history): reproduced statically (_plan_append calls validate_event_sequence over _session_history per append) but cost is bounded by MAX_SESSION_EVENTS=9216 and MAX_SESSION_CANONICAL_BYTES; accepted tradeoff / not a correctness defect.
